title: CapyIMG joins the creative projects
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: a new creative project, stricter text limits, and fewer model settings hiding in the walls.

CapyUniverse's CapyIMG was added to the creative-project lineup, giving people another open experiment to explore and build around.

The API now treats max_tokens as an actual hard ceiling rather than a polite suggestion users could override. Predictable output limits: a small but civilized improvement.

Provider data moved into one shared model-cost source, the transform pipeline was split into modular pieces, and the model catalog was streamlined around GPT-4.1 Nano. Less scattered configuration means a saner base for future model work.
